issues.problem: Update dialog retains unsaved comments after Cancel or Close and reopening.
issues.expected: Comments reset to empty when reopening the dialog.
issues.classification: Deployed application behavior; test assertions retained.

issues.problem: Group tree rows are buttons and do not expose role=treeitem.
issues.expected: Tree items provide the treeitem accessibility role.
issues.classification: Observed deployed UI accessibility difference; assertion retained.

issues.problem: Features tab renders its table and controls without the expected Manage Features heading.
issues.expected: Visible Manage Features heading.
issues.classification: Observed deployed UI difference; assertion retained.

issues.problem: Save remains enabled with empty required fields.
issues.expected: Save disabled while required role fields are empty.
issues.classification: Deployed UI behavior differs from disabled-state assertions; assertions retained.

issues.problem: The account header displays an identity-provider identifier instead of the required email address.
issues.expected: The signed-in account email is visible in the header.
issues.observed: Live header inspection found a 36-character account identifier in the account label; no email was present.
issues.classification: Confirmed application defect. User confirmed the email requirement. Original email assertion restored and failure retained.

issues.tab: System User Dashboard / Pending Requests / Approval
issues.problem: The Role combobox has no accessible name or association with the visible Role label.
issues.expected: Role control is discoverable by its label after profile selection.
issues.observed: Independent live inspection: button role=combobox, no id, aria-label, or aria-labelledby; visible Select Role control and adjacent Role text.
issues.classification: Confirmed accessibility defect; affected scenarios remain failed. Dependent role selection checks did not complete.

issues.tab: System User Dashboard / Pending Requests / Search
issues.problem: Hardware ID is displayed as an unquoted signed number; the existing scenario explicitly requires a quoted numeric value.
issues.expected: Quoted numeric hardware ID per reviewed test plan.
issues.classification: Observed UI and scenario mismatch retained as failure. Hardware-ID search behavior was not reached.

issues.tab: System User Dashboard / Pending Requests / Search
issues.problem: Delete is an icon button with an accessible Delete LR identifier but no visible text; the scenario extracts visible button text.
issues.expected: Visible Delete LR-XXXXX text per reviewed test plan.
issues.classification: Observed UI and scenario mismatch retained as failure. Request-ID search behavior was not reached.

issues.tab: System User Dashboard / Pending Requests / Search
issues.problem: Pressing Escape leaves the entered search text unchanged.
issues.expected: Escape clears search and restores the list.
issues.observed: Independent check: search value remained Test after Escape.
issues.classification: Confirmed application behavior violates the scenario; assertion retained.

issues.tab: System User Dashboard / Pending Requests / Approval
issues.problem: Changing the selected user group retains the previously selected profile.
issues.expected: Profile resets to Select Profile on user group change.
issues.observed: Changed from LIMAS-Root-Group to Default; DatabaseDesigner NG remained selected.
issues.classification: Confirmed application behavior violates the scenario; assertion retained.

issues.tab: System User Dashboard / Pending Requests / Approval
issues.problem: Escape does not close the inline approval form.
issues.expected: Escape closes the form without submission.
issues.observed: Independent check: License Assignment remained visible after Escape.
issues.classification: Confirmed application defect. Locator repaired and rerun still fails the Escape-close assertion.

issues.tab: System User Dashboard / Processed History / Search
issues.problem: Search input preserves leading whitespace instead of trimming it.
issues.expected: Leading whitespace is trimmed by the input control.
issues.classification: Confirmed by rerun using actual input events; requirement retained.

issues.tab: System User Dashboard / Processed History / Search
issues.problem: Typing a search term triggers a processed-request API call.
issues.expected: Client-side filtering without a new processed-request API call.
issues.classification: Reproduced after repairing search data selection; requirement retained.

issues.problem: The loading footer exposes aria-live=polite, while the existing scenario expects no live region.
issues.expected: No live region per the existing absence-check scenario.
issues.classification: Accessibility behavior differs from the existing scenario; presence of a live region is not itself a product defect. Requirement review needed; assertion retained.

issues.problem: The Expires before caption is a semantic label, while the existing scenario expects a non-label element.
issues.expected: Non-label element per the existing limitation-documentation scenario.
issues.classification: Accessibility improvement differs from the existing scenario; not classified as a product defect. Requirement review needed; assertion retained.

issues.problem: Returning to Pending Requests reuses the loaded list without issuing a new pending request API call.
issues.expected: The existing scenario requires a new pending API response after disabling history.
issues.classification: Independent UI observation confirms list restoration with no second pending response. Requirement difference retained as failed; API path was correct.

issues.problem: Date fields are hidden until a profile is selected; existing scenarios inspect them immediately after opening the form.
issues.expected: Existing steps expect the date labels to be visible immediately.
issues.classification: Conditional UI behavior confirmed. Failed assertions retained pending requirement review; labels are associated correctly once fields appear.

issues.problem: The specified ArrowUp/Tab segment sequence leaves the date incomplete in Edge.
issues.expected: A complete ISO date after the specified keyboard sequence.
issues.classification: Reproduced independently. ArrowRight segment navigation sets a date; prescribed Tab sequence does not. Failure retained, browser-native keyboard behavior requires scenario review.

issues.problem: Tab from the Expiring Licenses card focuses the two following summary cards before reaching the Expiration radio.
issues.expected: The existing scenario expects the radio after one Tab.
issues.classification: Keyboard navigation works in visual DOM order; old one-Tab assumption differs from UI. Failed result retained for requirement review.

issues.problem: Empty search results display a heading and guidance text.
issues.expected: The existing scenario explicitly expects no no-match message.
issues.classification: Helpful empty-state messaging differs from the old absence-check scenario; not classified as a product defect. Failure retained for requirement review.

issues.problem: The prescribed focus sequence includes disabled Maintenance and Approve controls; after Cancel, focus leaves the document.
issues.expected: All listed fields and buttons reachable through the fixed Tab sequence.
issues.classification: Independent focus sequence recorded. Disabled controls are skipped by native keyboard navigation; requirement and setup review needed. Original failure retained.

issues.problem: Focus remains on the Expiration radio after switching filters.
issues.expected: The old absence-check scenario expects document BODY to be active.
issues.classification: Focus preservation verified independently; not classified as a product defect. Failed absence assertion retained for requirement review.

issues.problem: The background Extend button has no accessible name while its ancestor is aria-hidden under the open modal.
issues.expected: The existing scenario expects the background button accessible name to remain Extend.
issues.classification: Standard modal accessibility isolation differs from the scenario; not classified as a product defect. Failure retained after repairing locator scope.

issues.problem: The numeric Extend by Days control rejects alphabetic keyboard input.
issues.expected: The existing scenario expects the input value abc.
issues.observed: Typing abc leaves the value empty. The same result occurs independently and in the corrected test.
issues.classification: Confirmed scenario failure; numeric-control behavior conflicts with the old acceptance expectation. Expected value retained for requirement review.

issues.tab: System User Dashboard / Expiring Floating Configurations
issues.problem: Tab from the native date control proceeds through its remaining segment and following controls; it does not reach the preceding radio group.
issues.expected: The prescribed step expects the radio group immediately after the date control.
issues.classification: Observed keyboard order differs from the scenario. Original focus assertions retained for requirement review.

issues.tab: System User Dashboard / Expiring Floating Configurations
issues.problem: Changing the radio filter loses keyboard focus after the data response.
issues.expected: Focus remains on the selected radio and subsequent arrow keys change selection.
issues.observed: After switching to Maintenance, the active element becomes BODY. ArrowLeft then leaves Maintenance selected.
issues.classification: Independently confirmed application keyboard-focus defect; original expectations retained.

issues.tab: System User Dashboard / Expiring Floating Configurations
issues.problem: Typing invalid alphabetic text in the empty native date control leaves it empty and sends no request.
issues.expected: The scenario expects a default-date GET after invalid input.
issues.classification: Native date input rejects alphabetic characters without changing its value. Scenario expectation retained as failed for requirement review; not classified as a confirmed application defect.

issues.problem: Save remains enabled when required inputs are empty, including after clearing the name.
issues.expected: Save disabled until required fields are populated.
issues.classification: Independently confirmed UI requirement failure; no submission performed and assertions retained.

issues.problem: No user card is selected on initial load; the first user gains its selected ring only after clicking.
issues.expected: First user auto-selected on page load.
issues.classification: Independently confirmed UI requirement failure; added explicit selection assertion to prevent a false pass based only on unrelated initial license records.

issues.problem: User and license Edit icon buttons have no accessible label; Delete buttons do.
issues.expected: Edit controls discoverable by their accessible names.
issues.classification: Independently observed accessibility issue. Existing Edit-name assertions retained.

issues.problem: Rapid typing sends one debounced request; revisiting page 1 and clearing search reuse cached results without a new GET.
issues.classification: Observed behavior conflicts with existing no-debounce/fresh-request expectations. Retained for requirement review, not automatically classified as a product defect.

issues.problem: Hardware-ID filtering returns matching users but the license panel includes their other hardware IDs as well.
issues.expected: Every displayed license hardware ID matches the search term.
issues.classification: Independently verified requirement failure; assertion retained.

issues.problem: Download becomes enabled after selecting a user even while All Profiles is active.
issues.expected: This scenario expects Download disabled until a specific profile is applied.
issues.classification: Verified requirement mismatch; original disabled-state assertion retained.

issues.tab: User & License Hub / Hardware search with selection
issues.problem: Changing the hardware search clears user selection and disables Download.
issues.expected: This scenario expects Download to remain enabled with a selected user and active profile.
issues.classification: Consistent with independently observed filter-induced selection reset; original assertion retained.

issues.tab: User & License Hub / Download after All Profiles reset
issues.problem: Download remains enabled after All Profiles is restored while a user remains selected.
issues.expected: The scenarios require Download disabled after restoring All Profiles.
issues.classification: Observed requirement mismatch consistent with Download requiring user selection but not a specific profile; disabled-state assertions retained.

issues.problem: Cancelling and reopening Add License retains the unsaved Hardware ID.
issues.expected: Reopened dialog is empty.
issues.classification: Independently confirmed UI requirement failure; no license submitted.
Confirmed application failure after authorized live approval
issues.problem: Approving Test User request LR-15803 creates the user (POST /limas/api/users: 201), then PUT /limas/api/users returns 500. UI shows Failed to approve the request. Please try again. Request remains pending after fresh navigation; User & License Hub shows Test User in Default group with 0 licenses.
issues.expected: Selected request is approved, the license is assigned, and the pending count decreases by one.
issues.notes: Original skip was superseded by an executed failure. No second approval was submitted. The response observer was subsequently narrowed to the observed PUT update endpoint; the original failing result is preserved.

issues.problem: Opening Edit License places initial focus on a date input rather than the expected Role combobox. It remains on the input after the dialog settles.
issues.expected: Initial keyboard focus is on Role.
issues.classification: Independently confirmed UI requirement failure; assertions retained.

issues.problem: After Cancel closes the dialog, document focus falls back to BODY instead of returning to the Edit trigger.
issues.expected: Focus returns to the invoking Edit button.
issues.classification: Independently confirmed UI requirement failure; assertions retained.

issues.problem: The automated focus-trap assertion found no focused descendant after 15 Tab presses. An independent 15-Tab inspection kept document.activeElement inside the dialog on every step.
issues.expected: Keyboard focus stays within the modal.
issues.classification: Intermittent focus observation requires review; not classified as a confirmed application defect.
issues.followUp: LIMAS-SUD-1415 passed the final diagnostic rerun with activeInsideDialog=true, cssFocusedDescendants=1 and documentHasFocus=true. Earlier failures remain recorded; no underlying application fix is claimed.
